title: Collective Counterfactual Planning: Coordination, Consent, and Verification under Representational Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.17932v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Groups routinely complete projects that no single member can plan, execute, or verify alone. We propose a formal model of this phenomenon, Collective Counterfactual Planning (CCP), in which the binding limitation on each agent is neither capability, knowledge, nor observability, but representational geometry: each agent perceives the state, conceives moves, consents to actions, and certifies goal requirements only through a projection onto an agent-specific subspace of a common task space. Four gates jointly determine whether a team can reach a conjunctive goal and legitimately recognize that it has done so: the exogenous implementation coalitions required to perform each action, together with three representational gates -- conception, consent, and task-relative verification qualification. translated_title: 集体反事实规划：表征约束下的协调、同意与验证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17932v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：群体通常能完成单个成员无法独立规划、执行或验证的项目。我们提出了这一现象的正式模型——集体反事实规划（CCP），其中每个代理的约束限制既不是能力、知识，也不是可观测性，而是表征几何：每个代理仅通过对共同任务空间的特定子空间的投影来感知状态、构思行动、同意行为并认证目标要求。四个门控共同决定团队是否能达到合取目标并合法地认识到这一点：执行每个行动所需的外生实施联盟，以及三个表征门控——构思、同意和任务相关验证资格。我们定义了集体反事实可解性（CCS）问题，区分了几何可行性、可执行达成和验证完成。
tldr: 本文提出集体反事实规划模型，强调代理间的核心限制是表征几何而非能力或知识，通过四个门控（实施联盟、构思、同意和验证资格）来判定团队达成合取目标及合法识别的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Collective Counterfactual Planning, where the key constraint is representational geometry, and uses four gates to determine whether a team can reach and legitimately recognize conjunctive goals.
